name: 02_capability_gate_survivors_ordered_by_cost
description: After capability gating, the SURVIVORS are still ordered by their judgement dims — proving the gate is purely additive and does not touch cost. A GPU embed job in region CH requires gpu:burst AND geo:CH. Four options with distinct financial costs. Only 'gpu-ch' (cheapest GPU+CH) and 'gpu-ch2' (pricier GPU+CH) offer both; 'gpu-us' is wrong geo, 'cpu-ch' has no GPU. Both must drop, and the two survivors must come back gpu-ch (0.2) before gpu-ch2 (0.5) on both cores.
